summary: ProFrac Holding Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that its indirect subsidiary entered into a new $300M senior secured asset-based revolving credit facility with Eclipse Business Capital LLC, maturing July 1, 2030. The facility was used to refinance and terminate the prior credit agreement. Terms include SOFR-based pricing with margins of 4.00%-4.50%, a 2.00% floor, and an unused line fee of 0.500% per annum. The obligations are guaranteed and secured by substantially all assets of the borrower and guarantors. This is a routine refinancing of existing debt, not a special situation, as it does not involve acquisitions, divestitures, or other corporate events.
